reason: It's a brand I've never heard of, there's nothing here from real customers, and I can't try anything on. I can get a decent secondhand tee on Depop for $8 to $12, so $38 for a new one is a lot when I only make about $13k a year.
objection: I can't try it on and it's a boxy fit, so what if the size is wrong? There are no real customer photos or reviews, and it doesn't say anything about returns, so I'd be stuck with a $38 tee I can't wear.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of real customer reviews with photos on different body types and size info, plus free and easy returns. Even then I'd probably only try the tee, not the hoodie or jeans.
